about.title: About Mortgage APR Calculator - Annual Percentage Rate (APR) Analysis Tool
about.description: The Mortgage APR Calculator helps you determine the true annual cost of a home loan by calculating APR, which includes interest rate plus lender fees, discount points, and other financing charges. Use this tool to compare loan offers, understand the impact of fees, and see how points change your APR and total borrowing cost.

howTo.title: How to Use the Mortgage APR Calculator

steps.title: Enter Loan Amount
steps.description: Input the mortgage principal you plan to borrow (after down payment).

steps.title: Set Interest Rate and Term
steps.description: Provide the nominal interest rate and loan term (e.g., 15 or 30 years).

steps.title: Add Fees and Points
steps.description: Include origination fees, discount points, underwriting, and other prepaid finance charges.

steps.title: Select Payment Schedule
steps.description: Most mortgages use monthly payments; confirm any special schedules if applicable.

steps.title: Calculate APR
steps.description: Review computed APR, monthly payment, and total cost over the life of the loan.

tips: APR includes finance charges; interest rate alone does not
Points lower the rate but raise upfront costs—use APR to compare fairly
Compare identical terms (fixed vs ARM, same term length) when using APR
Exclude escrow deposits (taxes/insurance) since they are not finance charges

features.title: APR vs Interest Rate
features.description: Side-by-side comparison shows how fees make APR higher than the nominal rate.

features.title: Fees and Points Breakdown
features.description: Itemize origination, underwriting, discount points, and other prepaid finance charges.

features.title: Effective Cost Over Time
features.description: See total interest and financed fees across the full loan term.

features.title: Points Break-Even
features.description: Find the time needed to recoup discount points through reduced monthly payments.

features.title: Offer Comparison
features.description: Compare multiple lender offers using consistent APR methodology.

faq.q: What is APR on a mortgage?
faq.a: APR is the annualized cost of borrowing including the interest rate plus certain lender fees and prepaid finance charges. It helps compare loans with different fee structures.

faq.q: How is APR different from the interest rate?
faq.a: The interest rate reflects the cost of borrowing principal only. APR adds eligible fees (like points and origination) to reflect the loan’s true annual cost.

faq.q: Which fees are included in APR?
faq.a: Typically origination fees, discount points, underwriting, and some closing costs directly tied to securing credit. Taxes, insurance, escrow deposits, and title fees are usually excluded.

faq.q: Is APR always higher than the interest rate?
faq.a: Generally yes, because APR includes fees. In rare cases with lender credits, APR could be close to or slightly below the nominal rate.
